patterns.what_worked: Every Forever hazard was derived from origin/forever API docs (secret markers, C_SwingTimer, C_CombatLog restriction) and matched to addon file:line before editing; all guards are capability-gated so classic clients execute the same code path.
patterns.what_was_hard: Distinguishing a refused load from runtime secret-value errors: the load path itself has no unguarded absent API, so the fixes target the restricted-value call sites the operator described.
patterns.skill_gap: The headless harness cannot reproduce the client's secret-value throw; regression tests assert the fallback path instead.

escalation.recommendation: In-game check on WoW Forever with /sst diag.
